_about: Known-answer facts and questions for the retrieval bench (#1242). Each fact is one message placed in the seeded space; distractors are near-miss messages on the same topic. Each question names its gold facts. `keywords` is what an agent would type, taken from the QUESTION's words only (never the gold message's); `keywords_other` is their literal translation into the other language (Polish or English), as an agent asked to search in both languages would add. `answer_check` is a case-insensitive regex an answer must match for answer accuracy. Categories: exact (rare tokens shared), inflect (Polish inflection differs), paraphrase (other words, same language), crosslang (question and message in different languages), nodiacritics (Polish typed without diacritics), typo, temporal (needs a date filter or the latest of several), recent (inside today's 40-message window).

facts.author: bogdan
facts.text: Zamówienie na 400 sztuk SHT45 poszło dziś do TME, numer zamówienia TME-2026-04471. Dostawa ma być za 3 tygodnie.

facts.author: ada
facts.text: Ustalone na dzisiejszym spotkaniu: w nowej wersji stacji zostajemy przy Sensirion SHT45, a BME688 odpada, bo w trybie gazowym zużywał za dużo prądu.

distractors.author: piotr
distractors.text: A może jednak BME688 w nowej wersji? Ma pomiar gazów, klienci z miast by to docenili.

distractors.author: ada
distractors.text: Ustalone: obudowę zamawiamy w kolorze grafitowym, biały za szybko żółknie na słońcu.

facts.author: piotr
facts.text: Test baterii zakończony: przy pomiarze co 10 minut stacja wytrzymała 14 miesięcy na dwóch ogniwach 18650 (symulacja przyspieszona).

distractors.author: piotr
distractors.text: Ruszył przyspieszony test baterii, wyniki za jakieś trzy tygodnie.

facts.author: marta
facts.text: Po kalibracji w komorze klimatycznej wychodzi stały offset +0,8°C dla serii z lutego; poprawkę wpisałam do firmware 2.3.1.

facts.author: jonas
facts.text: Rolling back firmware 2.4.0 on all field units: it bricks the LoRa radio after a watchdog reset. We're back on 2.3.1 until Marta's fix lands.

facts.author: piotr
facts.text: Bramka LoRaWAN na dachu biurowca przy Grunwaldzkiej ma zasięg ok. 2,7 km, sprawdziłem rowerem z nadajnikiem testowym.

facts.author: ola
facts.text: Obudowy od Plastmetu przeszły test szczelności IP67, ale uszczelka przy dławiku pęka po 200 cyklach termicznych. Trzeba zmienić materiał na EPDM.

facts.author: bogdan

facts.author: ada

facts.author: marta

facts.author: marta
facts.text: Widełki dla junior QA: 7–9 tys. zł brutto na umowę o pracę.

facts.author: sarah
facts.text: Decision: we're moving PCB assembly from Satel-Tech to Eurocircuits starting with the June batch. Satel-Tech's lead time slipped to 9 weeks.

distractors.author: sarah

facts.author: bogdan

facts.author: ola

facts.author: piotr

facts.author: sarah

facts.author: jonas

facts.author: ada

facts.author: jonas

facts.author: sarah

facts.author: jonas

facts.author: piotr

facts.author: ada
facts.text: Firma zamknięta 10–21 sierpnia, dyżur techniczny ma Piotr.

facts.author: bogdan
facts.text: Wniosek do NCBR (Szybka Ścieżka) złożony, budżet projektu 3,1 mln zł, wynik w listopadzie.

facts.author: ada

facts.author: bogdan

facts.author: ola

access_checks.what: A person loses a restricted space's grant; the next search by that person no longer finds its messages.
A space's AI is turned off; an agent's search no longer finds its messages.
A company guest never finds messages of a workspace-visible space they were not added to.
A person removed from the company finds nothing.

deletion_checks.what: A message removed by its author (removed_at) is not found by text or meaning, at once.
A message deleted outright (DELETE) is not found, at once.
An edited message is not found by the words the edit removed, at once, and is found by its new words once indexed.
